bullets.body: A Monday arxiv release (2605.07588) opened the research week by extending the weekend's loader-verification line from the agent-loader surface to the local-fine-tuning training surface, presenting a checkpoint-provenance verification model that carries the five-surface compositional safety guarantees through the LoRA and router-only training pipeline rather than only the inference-time loader.
